Symptoms: Engine won't start, no cranking sound
Probable Cause(s): Dead battery, corroded terminals, bad starter relay
What Mechanic Checks: Battery Voltage (should be 12.6V+), terminal connections, relay click

Probable Cause(s): No fuel delivery, bad spark plugs, failed crankshaft sensor
What Mechanic Checks: Fuel pump prime sound, spark plug condition, diagnostic codes

Probable Cause(s): Low coolant, broken thermostat, failed water pump, blown head gasket
What Mechanic Checks: Coolant level, thermostat operation, radiator flow, oil for milky residue

Probable Cause(s): Coolant burning in combustion (head gasket), condensation (normal cold start)
What Mechanic Checks: Head gasket integrity, coolant level drop, oil contamination

Probable Cause(s): Rich fuel mixture, clogged air filter, faulty fuel injectors
What Mechanic Checks: Air filter condition, injector spray pattern, O2 sensor reading

Probable Cause(s): Oil burning in combustion, worn piston rings or valve seals
What Mechanic Checks: Oil consumption rate, PCV valve, compression test per cylinder

Symptoms: Car pulls to one side while braking
Probable Cause(s): Uneven brake pad wear, stuck caliper, brake fluid leak
What Mechanic Checks: Brake pad thickness per wheel, caliper slide pins, brake lines

Probable Cause(s): Worn brake pads metal-on-metal, warped rotors
What Mechanic Checks: Brake pad thickness, rotor surface condition, caliper operation

Probable Cause(s): Worn brake pad indicator contacting rotor
What Mechanic Checks: Brake pad wear indicator level

Symptoms: Steering wheel vibrates at high speed
Probable Cause(s): Wheel imbalance, worn tie rod ends, damaged CV joint
What Mechanic Checks: Wheel balance, front-end play, CV boot for grease leaks

Probable Cause(s): Misfiring cylinder, worn engine mounts, vacuum leak
What Mechanic Checks: Spark plug/coil condition, engine mount rubber, intake manifold seals

Probable Cause(s): Failing alternator, loose serpentine belt, bad battery
What Mechanic Checks: Alternator output voltage (should be 13.5-14.5V running), belt tension

Probable Cause(s): Multiple possible faults — read OBD-II codes first
What Mechanic Checks: Connect OBD scanner to read diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs)

Probable Cause(s): Low refrigerant, failed compressor, clogged condenser
What Mechanic Checks: Refrigerant pressure, compressor clutch engagement, condenser fins

Symptoms: Knocking sound from engine under load
Probable Cause(s): Low oil pressure, worn main bearings, detonation/pinging
What Mechanic Checks: Oil level and pressure, bearing clearance, fuel octane rating

Probable Cause(s): Idle air control valve dirty, vacuum leak, low fuel pressure
What Mechanic Checks: AC valve cleaning, intake vacuum lines, fuel pressure at idle

Probable Cause(s): Dirty air filter, faulty O2 sensor, stuck-open injector, spark plugs
What Mechanic Checks: Air filter, O2 sensor live data, injector flow rate, plug condition

Probable Cause(s): Low oil level, failing oil pump, blocked oil filter, worn bearings
What Mechanic Checks: Oil level first — top up if low; then pressure test; filter condition

Probable Cause(s): Low transmission fluid, worn clutch plates, solenoid fault
What Mechanic Checks: Fluid level and condition (color/smell), solenoid codes, clutch pack

Probable Cause(s): Worn outer CV joint, low CV joint grease, damaged CV boot
What Mechanic Checks: CV boot for cracks/grease loss, joint play during turning
